name: Copy research file builder
why: Sorts product material and past messages into research files before any copy is written.

name: Mine your product's own words and find the shared want
why: A guided run at message mining: phrases sorted for headlines and the one want buyers share.

name: Switch story mapper
why: Maps recent buyers' stories onto push, pull, anxiety and habit, the forces this kit uses for objections and email sequences.

name: Market stage reader
why: Reads what buyers already know and how worn the category's claims are, then writes a headline brief.

name: Write a headline that fits what your buyers already know
why: Stage-matched headlines with a promise check and a test plan, in line with the awareness rules here.

name: Ad-matched landing page writer
why: Writes landing page copy that picks up where the ad left off, for message match.

name: Landing page conversion review
why: A second, independent review of a page's conversion problems ranked by impact.

name: Hardest objections answer writer
why: Finds the toughest objections and writes fair answers that admit their limits.

name: Claim evidence checker
why: Checks which claims are supported and which go too far, before copy ships.

name: Guarantee designer
why: Designs a guarantee that fits the business's risk, with the refund sums worked out.

name: Follow-up email sequence writer
why: Turns one email into follow-ups with a new reason each, one ask, timing and a stop rule.

name: Write headlines and pick the winner with a small test
why: Headline generation plus a small keyed test, for when a full A/B test is out of reach.

name: A/B test traffic checker
why: Works out the test size and weeks needed, so tests are sized before launch.

name: Anti-AI-slop copy editor
why: Fixes machine-sounding lines in drafts, the main failure of AI-written copy.
